what: A 36px circular arrow button sits in the card’s bottom-left corner (within 14px). When the pointer is anywhere over the card, it stretches in .5s cubic-bezier(.85,0,.3,1) into a pill as wide as the title. The title switches on .3s later, sliding in from 12px to the left over .3s. On release the title leaves right away in .3s and the button returns to a circle in .5s. Over the button, a 1px and 6px faded background-color ring appears around it in .2s

options.dur: Duration in seconds for the pill to grow and shrink, default .5
options.delay: Delay before the title turns on (sec), default .3
options.shift: Distance the title travels in (px), default -12
options.size: Diameter (px) of the closed circle, default 36 — keep the same as --fx-size in css
options.--fx-chip · --fx-ring · --fx-ring-hover: Button background · resting outline · hover outline · corner inset distance (via style)
options.[data-fx-part=chip]: Expanding button (link) — a positioned spot inside the element it is attached to
options.[data-fx-part=icon]: 36px icon slot at the button’s right end

use: Project Name

from.where: index.html .nf-case (three project cards — ExpandedCornerLink, framer-motion width auto .5s [.85,0,.3,1] · title opacity·x .3s delayed by .3)

note: The original used framer-motion’s width: auto when expanding — here GSAP width: "auto" Measures the same end width. On touch devices a press is the link itself, so it navigates without stretching
